objective: Determine whether M473/M498 exact parent-result reuse can replace its physically expensive 64x1152b 1R1W scratch with nine existing generated 128x128b 1RW single-port macros by hiding parent reads under non-final residual issue cycles and using same-address write-to-prefetch forwarding.

frozen_coordinate.arithmetic: Exact signed12 parent/residual reconstruction and signed19 resident psum; no checkpoint or accuracy change.

single_port_schedule.macro_rule: At most one 1152-bit scratch read or one 1152-bit scratch write per cycle.
single_port_schedule.issue_order: Ascending original popcount then ascending row index, identical to M473.
single_port_schedule.parent_edge_order: Prefetches occur in future consumer issue order and feed the existing two-entry FIFO; every parent edge is read independently.
single_port_schedule.producer_validity: A parent may be read only after its topologically prior row has completed and written scratch.
single_port_schedule.response_latency: A macro read accepted in cycle t can enter the response FIFO at the t+1 edge and cannot satisfy issue in cycle t.
single_port_schedule.capacity: M498 fail-closed reservation uses queue occupancy plus one pending synchronous read; current consume never credits same-cycle prefetch readiness.
single_port_schedule.forwarding: If the next parent edge reads the current final-write row, the write data is enqueued directly and no macro read occurs.
single_port_schedule.write: Every active row writes on its final issue cycle; no separate completion cycle is introduced.
single_port_schedule.optimization: Earliest in-order eligible parent-edge prefetch. Since consumers and FIFO are in the same order, delaying an eligible earliest read cannot make any consumer ready earlier.

cycle_model.pipeline_equation: M473 exact selected-coordinate equation: preprocess[0] + sum(max(work[i], preprocess[i+1])+2) + work[last]+2 per sample, with preprocess=max(product_frontend,160) for nonempty tasks.
cycle_model.comparison: Only per-task product work changes from 8*ideal_issue to 8*single_port_issue_window; frontend, DMA, tail and commit remain frozen.

macro_model.single_port_generated: 9 x generated TS1N28HPCPHVTB128X128M4S using lower 64 rows and 1152/1152 bits
macro_model.boundary: The DP value is a foundry-QRT exact-capacity fallback and the SP value is a generated-view over-depth mapping. This audit is not integrated post-layout PPA or macro-inclusive power.

materiality_gates.rtl_rule: All three gates plus independent hammer must pass before M504 RTL is authorized.

fail_closed: Abort on any frozen SHA or M473 selected-coordinate drift.
Abort if a scratch read occurs before its producer row has completed.
Abort on simultaneous single-port macro read and write.
Abort if any parent edge is dropped, merged, or served out of FIFO consumer order.
Abort if the reconstructed ideal 1R1W cycle total differs from the frozen M473 389974420-cycle anchor.
Never call the foundry-QRT DP fallback or generated SP mapping integrated PPA.
Never call a passing cycle audit RTL, Synopsys, system speedup, or DATE headline evidence.
